(()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;const marks=['Ready to Deploy','Bench Laptop Model','Purchased','Bench Assignee','Checked out'];const res={};marks.forEach(m=>{const i=t.indexOf(m);res[m]=i<0?'NOT FOUND':t.slice(Math.max(0,i-90),i+120).replace(/\n+/g,' | ');});res['len']=t.length;return JSON.stringify(res,null,1);})()
